children: WASHINGTON (dpa-AFX) - Robinhood Markets, Inc. (HOOD) revealed a profit for third quarter that Drops, from the same period last year
The company's bottom line totaled $468 million, or $0.51 per share.  This compares with $556 million, or $0.61 per share, last year.
Excluding items, Robinhood Markets, Inc. reported adjusted earnings of $550 million or $0.60 per share for the period.
The company's revenue for the period rose 11.8% to $1.424 billion from $1.274 billion last year.
